value.rationale: The exact bad-reduction set for a historically extremal nodal 52-line K3 quartic is a motivated intrinsic property of its published integral presentation, not an arbitrary computation. The all-prime principal-minor certificate distinguishes genuine equisingular reductions from the two discrete nodal jumps, while the special fiber in characteristic two exhibits a qualitatively different nonreduced double-plane singular scheme. The latter adds scheme information not supplied by the earlier observation of a singular line.
